title: GPT‑NL: a sovereign language model for the Netherlands
summary: GPT-NL is a sovereign Dutch language model developed by TNO (Netherlands Organisation for Applied Scientific Research) to provide Dutch organizations with a privacy-respecting AI solution that keeps data within national borders, reducing dependence on foreign cloud services and ensuring GDPR compliance.
problem_solved: Addresses data sovereignty concerns by enabling Dutch organizations to use advanced AI capabilities without sending sensitive data to foreign servers.
why_valuable: It provides a trusted, locally-hosted AI alternative that ensures regulatory compliance and data privacy while supporting the Dutch language natively.
